$description: PROPOSED `when` additions for the UNANIMOUS rows Dave ratified. s253-D1 shape (GATE — PROSE, one string). NEVER APPLIED by this script.

knowledge/components/input-fields.meta.j.when: entry = free text AND expected answer fits ONE line AND no fixed option list exists AND the value is not money, a date, a time or a secret — the default text-entry field; beats textarea (proposed "the answer may span multiple lines") whenever the answer is a name, a reference or a phone number; yields to amount-input when the value is money, to date-picker / time-picker when it is a date or time, to secure-entry when it is a one-time code or PIN, and to dropdown or combobox whenever the answer must come from a list at all (Carbon: free text there "is likely to result in an error").
